description: This file defines a custom WPF/UWP control class 'CalculatorButton' that extends the standard Button control, adding dependency properties for button identification, auditory feedback, and visual styling, along with event handling for key events and property changes.

classes.name: CalculatorButton
classes.description: A custom button control for calculator app with additional properties for button identification, styling, and feedback.

methods.name: CalculatorButton
methods.description: Constructor that initializes default command binding for the button.

methods.name: OnButtonIdPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the ButtonId property, updating command parameters accordingly.

methods.name: OnAuditoryFeedbackPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the AuditoryFeedback property, updating command parameters accordingly.

methods.name: OnKeyDown
methods.description: Overrides key down event to ignore the Enter key.

methods.name: OnKeyUp
methods.description: Overrides key up event to ignore the Enter key.
